body.objective: Derive the three endpoint matching constants of the BT transported projector from the oscillatory creation terms and Q_t squeezed vacuum, then test the resulting incoming/outgoing Gram against 1/48 without fitting.
body.current_gate: OSCILLATORY_ENDPOINT_MATCHING: transport the a1-dagger term in Eq. (33) and Q_t of Eq. (34) through the order-lambda projector, extract their delta/delta-prime/delta-double-prime endpoint action, and prove incoming/outgoing equality and idempotence on one test-function domain.
body.stop_condition: Construct and verify all three endpoint constants and the exact 1/48 Gram, or certify the first exact mismatch in oscillatory weak limits, squeeze contractions, projector identities, charge, coefficient, or incoming/outgoing equality.
body.forbid: no endpoint constant fitted to 1/48; no omission of Q_t or creation sectors; no plus or cutoff prescription called physical without dynamical matching; no final-only result; no Hilbert metric substitution; no scalar-to-gravity or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion; exact arithmetic only

Compare plus and cutoff bases only after matching coefficients are derived. Run sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
